Learn: Why parlays cost more
Every extra leg adds the house margin again.

A single bet at −110 (1.91).
If the true chance is 50%, you lose about 4.5% of every bet in the long run.

A 4-leg parlay at −110 each.
It returns about 13.3x your stake. A fair parlay of four 50% legs would return 16x.
That is about −17% EV: nearly four times the cost of a single bet.

Parlays are fun, but the price is higher. Treat them as entertainment, with small stakes.
